build_bert_model: build a BERT model with FP16 support and distributed data parallel wrapping for GPU training
setup_optimizer: set up an Adam optimizer with weight decay parameter groups and FP16 wrapping for BERT training
train_bert: train a BERT model with forward and backward steps, gradient clipping, and checkpoint saving
evaluate_bert: evaluate a BERT model on validation data and compute language modeling and next sentence prediction loss
pretrain_bert_main: run the main BERT pretraining program with distributed setup, data loading, and TensorBoard logging
